name: sistema-chat-websockets
description: Sistema de chat em tempo real com WebSockets, salas privadas e Redis

scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.install-all: npm run install-server && npm run install-client
scripts.dev-with-bot: concurrently "npm run dev" "npm run client" "npm run bot"
scripts.dev-with-advanced-bot: concurrently "npm run dev" "npm run client" "npm run advanced-bot"

author: Sistema de Chat
